title: Alex's Caves: Tremorzilla's Rage
description: Modifies alex's caves Tremorzilla mob to be significantly more powerful
body:
WARNING: THIS MOD IS NOT BUILT FOR LOWER-END PC'S, THIS MOD MAY CAUSE LAG!

 

Have you ever wanted to just see Tremorzilla from alex's caves unleash hell on the world, but never want to lift a finger yourself to do it?

Well, you've come to the right place! This mod makes tremorzilla, constantly angry, attacking everything on sight. Along with this, tremorzilla is far more destructive, leaving a radioactive wake of destruction wherever it's wrath may land.

Basics regarding the mod:

Tremorzilla spawns extremely rarely in the deep sea and even underground, you can also still summon him the normal way (artificially)

Along with this, a Life Annihilator item is added, a powerful bomb crafted with a wither star, two end crystals, iron trapdoor, iron blocks, and a soul campfire. The bomb's blast grows more powerful the more you right click it. It is reccomended to use this in point blank to Tremorzilla, and please note it still can be destroyed by Tremorzilla walking, meaning it would be reccomended to put it above or below tremorzilla.

Also: cadmium blaster, which nerfs tremorzilla's health an insane amount when a missile successfully hits it

SPOILER ALERT: if you manage to kill tremorzilla, your more than likely going to be blown up!

additional things:

ultimate tremorzilla (creative only feature), a version of tremorzilla that is ASTRONOMICALLY more powerful, has far more abilities, etc

Tremorzilla now has new growthstages! Including a small, lizard-like baby growth stage, and a teenager growth stage!

Tremorzilla's atomic breath is now MUCH stronger- bypassing most damage caps from other mods, bypassing resistance, and even bypassing armor. In other words, if you want to beat this thing safely, make sure you exhaust it's atomic breath first.

Tremorzilla will occasionally enter a frozen state (heavily inspired by Shin Godzilla) using a certain gamerule, rendering it inert for a bit under 3 minutes. In this time, you can get an opportunity to prep for it's return. Tremorzilla also periodically spawns minions (toxic cave entities and also mini-tremorzillas)

Tremorzilla can now enter a burning mode if right clicked on with a lava bucket, redstone block, or glowstone block! NOTE: This burning phase makes tremorzilla borderline invincible (unless you despawn it with items not from this mod), and insanely powerful, but after it expires, tremorzilla explodes with immense energy. Use with caution

THIS MOD REQUIRES ALEX'S CAVES TO WORK!

To disable the rage but keep everything else:

toggle IsTremorzillaAngry gamerule to false

 

Huge thanks to crazy_goggalcon4321 on discord for mod thumbnail!
